name: Callable type constructors require the callable type subsystem

input.fixture_ref: Parse and reify Closure<(Integer) -> String>, BoundMethod<(Integer) -> String>, and Block<(Integer) -> String>.

applicability.reason: Requires intersection Type syntax and callable signature metadata. All three callable kinds DO parse and execute: Closure<(Integer) -> Integer>, BoundMethod<() -> Integer> and Block<(Integer) -> Nil> each bind and call. What the row additionally needs is the intersection form, and `Closure<...> & Closure<...>` is a parse diagnostic, so intersection-versus-union precedence cannot be observed.

expect.status: Each callable annotation names Closure, BoundMethod, or Block around its signature; intersection binds tighter than union in the surrounding Type expression.
